tool_args.rationale: All five pilot rows have H≤0.48, far short of the H=20 forecast target. The selected probe tests whether delayed adaptation reverses the positive pilot response and helps constrain the slow term before fitting the sink-coupled model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term primarily constrains the ratio of adaptation amplitude to time constant, not the two parameters separately. That ratio is insufficient for a reliable forecast at H=20.
Finer time sampling is less directly informative about slow adaptation than extending the observation horizon.
It does not resolve the uncertainty in the slow adaptation term.
